_comment: OPTIONAL connectors that enhance brand-ecosystem-core skills. None are required: every bundled skill declares mcp_servers_required: [] and runs Claude.ai-native on the free tier. Enable only the ones you use. To activate, merge the desired entries into the plugin's .mcp.json (create it) or connect them in Claude.ai.

figma._use: figma-forge (DS-to-Figma libraries, variables, Code Connect) and brand-visual (visual identity handoff to Figma).

godaddy._use: brand-maker — live domain availability checks during naming validation.

exa._use: brand-audit — competitive landscape and IP/web research.
